span.p:
On eviction: pop root (freq=1 bucket), select entry from it
On access: increment frequency, move entry to next bucket
On frequency change: sift bucket up/down in heap
Naive LFU: O(log n) per access (heap operations)
Optimized LFU: O(1) with frequency partitioning
- Array of doubly-linked lists indexed by frequency
- Min frequency pointer maintained incrementally
Memory per entry:
- Same as LRU: ~52 bytes
- Plus frequency counter: 4 bytes
- Plus heap index: 4 bytes (naive implementation)
Total overhead: ~60 bytes per entry
